payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all good numbers up to 7 digits by bitmask over a/b choices, filter sums, count length-n strings via binomial coefficients.
payload.rationale: The solution precomputes the set of valid sums by iterating over all 2^7 combinations of digits a and b using bitmask enumeration, a complete search. Then it uses direct combinatorial counting (nCx) to sum over placements of a.
